message.scp_unleashed.scp4845.line.greet: Welcome in! What can I get started for you?
Hi there! Order whenever you're ready.
Welcome to Taco Spark! Can I take your order?
Hey! Long drive? Take your time with the menu.

message.scp_unleashed.scp4845.line.count: Will that be for here or to go?
Moon? What moon? We're right off the highway.
The Lunar Blast machine was just refilled, if you want one.
We're open late. Real late. Pretty much always, actually.
Sorry, the dining room's a little quiet tonight.
Your total comes up on the screen when you order.
Kyle says the drive-thru is a little slow tonight.
Have you tried the Cheesy Melt? It's my favourite.
message.scp_unleashed.scp4845.line.kitch: Sorry, staff only back here. Kidding. Mostly.
The walk-in's full again. It's always full.
I've been on this shift for... huh. A while.
Tacos for breakfast, burritos for lunch.
Don't mind the view. You get used to it.
We'll take the trash out later. It sort of takes itself out.
message.scp_unleashed.scp4845.line.manag: Hey! Kyle, assistant manager. Everything okay out there?
Just doing the numbers. The numbers are... fine.
Corporate keeps emailing. I keep not reading it.
If you see the boss, I was typing the whole time.
We've never missed a delivery. Not once. Don't ask how.
The schedule says I'm off at midnight. Every midnight.
The internet's great up here. I mean, out here.
Can't talk long, the inventory won't count itself. Well. It might.
Ow. Okay. I'm fine. Totally fine.
Sir, this is a Taco Spark.
Please don't do that, I just mopped.
That's going in the incident report.
message.scp_unleashed.scp4845.line.drift: I think I took a wrong turn on my break.
Have you seen the drive-thru? It was right here.
Is my shift over? Nobody told me.
This doesn't look like the parking lot.

dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.title: Open Late
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.caption: SCP-4845 as first photographed by the survey rover Bison-01. The drive-thru lane at right ends in open regolith.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.0.text.0: Images of the lunar surface around SCP-4845 are altered before release by Foundation staff placed within civilian space agencies.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.0.text.1: Approved personnel may dine at SCP-4845. Visitors are to pay for their orders, keep to the customer areas and leave the building and its fixtures undamaged.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.0.text.2: In return for the electricity it supplies to nearby installations, SCP-4845 receives an internet connection. All outgoing traffic is monitored.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.1.text.0: SCP-4845 is a fully operational fast-food restaurant of the Taco Spark chain, standing on the lunar surface with its parking lot, its signage and a drive-thru lane that leads nowhere.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.1.text.1: The interior holds a breathable atmosphere at ordinary pressure. The kitchen never runs short of power or ingredients, and the dumpster is always empty.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.1.text.2: SCP-4845 is staffed by humanoids designated SCP-4845-1. They describe themselves as ordinary employees and behave as such, taking orders, cooking, cleaning and taking breaks. They are friendly, polite and entirely unconcerned by their surroundings.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.1.text.3: SCP-4845-1 instances do not leave the building and are unaffected by vacuum or low gravity. Injuries are not retained. One instance, who gives his name as Kyle, describes himself as the assistant manager and spends most of his shift in the back office.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.2.title: Addendum 4845-1: Exploration Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.2.text: The survey rover Bison-01 reached SCP-4845 through a temporary passage opened by Site-120. An instance at the entrance held the door, asked whether the rover would be dining in, and waved as it left.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.3.title: Addendum 4845-2: Interview Excerpt
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.3.text.0: Asked how the restaurant came to be on the Moon, Kyle described a midnight shift, a flash of light and a window suddenly full of Earth. Asked who runs it, he said the boss calls sometimes, and that the boss probably would not take kindly to %rmeddlers%r.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.3.text.1: The interview ended when Kyle asked the interviewer whether that would be for here or to go.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.4.title: Addendum 4845-3: Notes
dossier.scp_unleashed.4845.page.4.text: A restaurant of the same chain was reported missing from a highway in Wyoming in 2013. Payments made at SCP-4845 cannot be recovered from the register. %rThe manager has never been seen.%r
